title: Some of the Directions Evident in Therapy
coreMove: Look for directional movement away from defense and toward owned experience, even when progress is uneven.
sourcePressure: The chapter identifies recurring directions of therapeutic movement without turning therapy into a fixed ladder. Frozen sidecar ch05 supports the heading, part placement, and broad thematic claims; it exposes no chapter-local named anecdotes, studies, or places.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Treating therapy as a neat stage sequence or equating visible emotion with growth.
sourceAnchorNote: The frozen source exposes no usable chapter-local named person, study, institution, place, date, or anecdotal artifact from Rogers here. Use fictional protagonists only; do not invent named Rogers cases or studies.

hook: opening with a definition of directions in therapy
